query: Item 7 Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A), and Item 8 Financial Statements and Supplementary Data sections specifically covering "Income Taxes" and "Commitments and Contingencies".

extraction.tax_onetime_note: Impact of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, composed of $2.0 billion remeasurement of net deferred tax assets/liabilities and $1.2 billion deemed repatriation tax, partially offset by a $1.7 billion impact on unrecognized tax benefits.
extraction.tax_contingency_note: Deemed repatriation tax payable of $33.589 billion to be paid in installments per the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act. Additionally, the European Commission State Aid Decision requires €13.1 billion plus €1.2 billion interest (approx. $16.3 billion at 2018 rates) held in escrow pending appeal, which is a potential future liability.
